limitations: The description concerns subscript positions and designators. Bounds, storage, calling convention, and aliases have separate rules.

statement: The February 1972 ALGOL W Language Description permits a whole array as an actual parameter specified by its array identifier when its subscript count matches the formal parameter. A higher-rank actual can fix positions with integer expressions and use one asterisk per remaining formal subscript, matched in source order.
